ui_bugs.issue: Both screens call router.back() after successful auth. When the user opens /login or /register directly via URL (or from a fresh navigation with no history), router.back() logs 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' and the user stays on the auth page (though session is set). Prefer router.replace('/home') or router.canGoBack() check. Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:30, /app/frontend/app/register.tsx:33.

react_native_issues.issue: Warning 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow' fires on every screen load. Consolidate to the shorthand `textShadow` style property. Non-blocking but noisy in web preview console.
Warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' fires on every screen. Move `pointerEvents` prop into `style` object. Non-blocking.

action_items: Replace router.back() with router.replace('/home') (or a smart canGoBack check) in /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:30 and /app/frontend/app/register.tsx:33 so a direct URL open still leaves the auth screen after success.
Optional: address 'textShadow*' and 'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings (react-native-web) for a clean console.

social.py: interactions collection has unique index on (user_id, obs_id, type), which drives unique-view counting via insert-catch in get_observation. Correct pattern.
social.py compute_scientific_value clamps 0..100 and rewards ISS/planets/Kp>=5 — verified end-to-end.
server.py wires auth_router, social_router, ai_router and calls ensure_*_indexes on startup — fails fast (good).

rca_of_issue: RCA of /feed crash: `mediaUrl(imageUrl)` is declared in /app/frontend/src/lib/client.ts:11 but three consumers (`src/components/ObservationCard.tsx:7`, `app/observation-detail.tsx:13`, `app/profile.tsx:11`) imported it from `@/src/lib/backend`. Because backend.ts did not export mediaUrl, at runtime `_srcLibBackend.mediaUrl` was undefined and calling it threw `TypeError: is not a function`, which surfaced immediately on /feed because ObservationCard is rendered for every feed item. Mitigation applied: added `import { apiFetch, mediaUrl } from './client'` and `export { mediaUrl }` in /app/frontend/src/lib/backend.ts. Verified /feed now renders ISS cards + all filter chips work (feed-scope-recent, feed-cat-ISS).
